name: India ASCI/CCPA
description: Advertising Standards Council of India & Central Consumer Protection Authority Guidelines
note: Rule IDs are our own labels, not official clause numbers, and the descriptions are plain-language summaries.

rules.title: Prominent Material Disclosure
rules.description: Influencer and promotional advertisements must clearly feature upfront disclosure such as '#Ad', '#Sponsored', or 'Advertisement' placed prominently within the opening text or first 3 seconds.
rules.source: ASCI Guidelines for Influencer Advertising & CCPA Misleading Advertisements Prevention Guidelines

rules.title: Substantiation of Medical Cure Claims
rules.description: Cosmetic products cannot claim to diagnose, cure, mitigate, or permanently eradicate diseases or conditions including acne, eczema, or psoriasis without statutory clinical drug license approval.
rules.source: ASCI Code Chapter I (Substantiation of Claims) & Drugs and Magic Remedies Act

rules.title: Greenwashing and Environmental Claims
rules.description: Generic claims like '100% eco-friendly', 'green', or 'sustainable' without verifiable lifecycle assessment metrics are misleading.
rules.source: ASCI Guidelines for Environmental and Green Claims 2024

rules.title: Comparative Superlatives
rules.description: Claims such as 'No.1', 'India's best', or 'only brand that works' require independent market leadership verification.
rules.source: ASCI Code Chapter IV (Fair Competition & Superlative Claims)
